Command: Do not add to the Law
Summary: Deuteronomy 12:32 guards the Law's wholeness from one side: 'What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto.' God's word is received whole, not enlarged by human addition.
Commandment: Do not add to the Law.
Application: Scripture's stated reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you (Deuteronomy 4:2).
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you (Deuteronomy 4:2).
Function: I hold this as moral law: a duty written for every age, not for one nation's courts. Deuteronomy 12:32 guards the Law's wholeness from one side. Scripture gives the reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you. The restraint is the prohibition itself: do not add to the Law.
